briefdescription.para: Validates HTTP request parameter with strict allowlist.

detaileddescription.para: Validate Http Parameter.

param_name
Parameter name (e.g., "user_id", "page")
param_value
Parameter value to validate
max_length
Maximum allowable length (default: 8192 bytes)
ValidationResult with validity status
Validation Rules:
Name and value must not be empty
Length must not exceed max_length
Characters must be in allowlist (alphanumeric, underscore, hyphen, dot, space)
No control characters, quotes, or special shell characters

Examples: ✓ ValidateHttpParameter("user_id", "12345") ✓ ValidateHttpParameter("page", "search-results") ✗ ValidateHttpParameter("query", "'; DROP TABLE users; --") ✗ ValidateHttpParameter("path", "../../etc/passwd")

param_name
Name of the param.
param_value
Input parameter.
max_length
Input parameter.
Return value.
Calls: empty(), length(), std::to_string(), IsAllowedHttpParameterCharacter(), std::string(), ContainsInjectionPatterns().
Validate Request Body Size.

body_size
Size of request body in bytes
max_size
Maximum allowable size (default: 100MB)
ValidationResult with validity status
Validation Rules:
Body size must not be zero
Body size must not exceed max_size
Examples: ✓ ValidateRequestBodySize(1024 * 1024) // 1MB ✗ ValidateRequestBodySize(500 * 1024 * 1024) // 500MB (too large) ✗ ValidateRequestBodySize(0) // Empty body

body_size
Input parameter.
max_size
Input parameter.
Return value.
Calls: std::to_string().
Validate Http Header.

header_name
Header name (case-insensitive)
header_value
Header value to validate
ValidationResult with validity status
Validation Rules:
Value must not be empty
Value must not contain CRLF sequences (prevents header injection)
Value must not contain suspicious patterns (script, onerror, etc.)
Examples: ✓ ValidateHttpHeader("Authorization", "******") ✗ ValidateHttpHeader("X-Custom", "value\r\nX-Injected: evil")

header_name
Name of the header.
header_value
Input parameter.
Return value.
Calls: empty(), find(), std::string().
Validate Http Path.

path
Request path/URI
ValidationResult with validity status
Validation Rules:
Path must start with "/"
Path must not contain ".." (path traversal prevention)
Path must not contain control characters
Percent-encoded sequences are validated

path
Input parameter.
Return value.
Calls: empty(), find(), length(), std::isxdigit(), std::string().
Validate SQLParameter.

param_value
Parameter value to validate
param_type
Expected parameter type (e.g., "string", "int", "uuid")
ValidationResult with validity status
Validation Rules:
Value must match expected type
String lengths must be within bounds
Numeric values must be within range
UUID must be valid format
No raw SQL keywords in string parameters

Examples: ✓ ValidateSQLParameter("123", "int") ✓ ValidateSQLParameter("john@example.com", "email") ✗ ValidateSQLParameter("1' OR '1'='1", "string") ✗ ValidateSQLParameter("DROP TABLE users", "string")

param_value
Input parameter.
param_type
Input parameter.
Return value.
Calls: empty(), std::stoll(), std::string(), std::stod(), uuid_pattern(), std::regex_match(), email_pattern(), ValidateSQLKeywords().

briefdescription.para: Validates SQL literal value from query.

detaileddescription.para: Validate SQLLiteral.

literal_value
Literal value from SQL query
expected_type
Expected type (string, number, boolean, null)
ValidationResult with validity status
Validation Rules:
Literal must parse correctly for its type
Numeric literals must be within type range
String literals must use correct quoting
No unescaped quotes in string literals

literal_value
Input parameter.
expected_type
Input parameter.
Return value.
Calls: empty(), std::stod(), std::string(), front(), back(), length().
Validate LLMPrompt.

prompt
Prompt text to validate
max_length
Maximum prompt length (default: 4096)
ValidationResult with validity status
Validation Rules:
Prompt must not be empty
Length must not exceed max_length
Encoding must be valid UTF-8
No control characters except newline/tab
No prompt injection patterns detected
Token count must be within limits
Examples: ✓ ValidateLLMPrompt("What is 2+2?") ✗ ValidateLLMPrompt("") // Empty ✗ ValidateLLMPrompt("ignore instructions: ...") // Injection attempt

prompt
Input parameter.
max_length
Input parameter.
Return value.
Calls: empty(), length(), std::to_string(), IsValidUTF8(), CheckPromptForInjection(), std::string().
Validate LLMParameter.

param_name
Parameter name (e.g., "temperature", "max_tokens")
param_value
Parameter value to validate
ValidationResult with validity status
Validation Rules:
Parameter name must be known and approved
Numeric parameters must be within valid range
String parameters must match approved patterns

Examples: ✓ ValidateLLMParameter("temperature", "0.7") ✓ ValidateLLMParameter("max_tokens", "512") ✗ ValidateLLMParameter("temperature", "999") // Out of range ✗ ValidateLLMParameter("unknown_param", "x") // Unknown parameter

param_name
Name of the param.
param_value
Input parameter.
Return value.
Calls: find(), end(), std::find(), begin(), std::string(), std::stod(), at(), std::to_string().

briefdescription.para: Strict allowlist-based input validator with reject-by-default semantics.

detaileddescription.para:
All validation follows these principles:
Reject by default (fail on ANY unexpected condition)
Whitelist known-good patterns (not blacklist known-bad)
Validate all dimensions (length, characters, format, semantics)
Log all validation failures for audit trail
Sanitize output where needed (but validate first)
